description: This Java class 'DefaultStreamCacheConfig' provides a default implementation of the 'StreamCacheConfig' interface, managing cache configuration parameters such as dispatcher name, retry delay, and cache size/expiration settings. It includes methods for instantiation from a configuration object, rendering configuration, and standard object methods.

classes.name: DefaultStreamCacheConfig
classes.description: Implements StreamCacheConfig, managing cache settings such as dispatcher name, retry delay, and cache expiration parameters.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of DefaultStreamCacheConfig from a given Config object.

methods.name: getDispatcherName
methods.description: Returns the dispatcher name used in cache configuration.

methods.name: getExpireAfterWrite
methods.description: Returns the expiration duration after write.

methods.name: getExpireAfterAccess
methods.description: Returns the expiration duration after access.

methods.name: getExpireAfterCreate
methods.description: Returns the expiration duration after creation.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the cache configuration as a Config object.
